digest.component_or_area: bug lifecycle / transition close / provenance linking
propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit ticket by blaming the pre-fix state of file_impact files and resolving the dominant commit's rebar-ticket: trailer

Single-culprit resolver returns a link only when >50% majority of blamed lines across file_impact point to one commit that resolves to a ticket; ambiguous cases (no majority, no trailer, no file_impact) yield None
The --caused-by <id> parameter overrides auto-derivation and is threaded through transition CLI/compute/close_ticket and the library facade transition()
Auto-derived and explicit caused_by links are written via _write_link_event directly to bypass the closed-source guard that rejects links from closed sources
Failure to resolve caused_by never blocks the close transaction; best-effort link is applied after the bug transitions to closed status
